title: New law: National Appliance Energy Conservation Act of 1987 (Public Law 100-12)
summary: S. 83 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-12 on 1987-03-17.

title: New law: A joint resolution to designate the month of March, 1987, as "Women's History Month". (Public Law 100-9)
summary: S.J.Res. 20 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-9 on 1987-03-12.

title: New law: A joint resolution to designate March 20, 1987 as "National Energy Education Day". (Public Law 100-15)
summary: S.J.Res. 19 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-15 on 1987-03-25.

title: New law: A joint resolution to recognize and acknowledge that February 14, 1987 will mark the 75th Anniversary of Arizona's Statehood, and to designate the year 1987 as Arizona's Diamond Jubilee. (Public Law 100-10)
summary: S.J.Res. 46 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-10 on 1987-03-12.

title: New law: A joint resolution to designate the week of April 5, 1987, through April 11, 1987, as "National Know Your Cholesterol Week". (Public Law 100-13)
summary: S.J.Res. 65 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-13 on 1987-03-20.

title: New law: A joint resolution to designate March 21, 1987 as "Afghanistan Day". (Public Law 100-16)
summary: S.J.Res. 63 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-16 on 1987-03-27.

title: New law: A bill to amend the National Housing Act to limit the fees that may be charged by the Government National Mortgage Association for the guaranty of mortgage-backed securities. (Public Law 100-14)
summary: H.R. 1056 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-14 on 1987-03-24.

title: New law: A joint resolution to provide for timely issuance of grants and loans by the Environmental Protection Agency under the Asbestos School Hazard Abatement Act of 1984 to ensure that eligible local educational agencies can complete asbestos abatement work in school buildings during the 1987 summer school recess. (Public Law 100-11)
summary: H.J.Res. 153 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-11 on 1987-03-17.

title: New law: A joint resolution to designate the week beginning March 1, 1987, as "Federal Employees Recognition Week". (Public Law 100-8)
summary: H.J.Res. 53 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-8 on 1987-03-06.

title: New law: A joint resolution to recognize the 100th anniversary of the enactment of the Hatch Act of March 2, 1887, and its role in establishing our Nation's system of State agricultural experiment stations. (Public Law 100-7)
summary: H.J.Res. 3 of the 100th Congress became Public Law 100-7 on 1987-03-05.
